package gocql
	type gocql.Batch struct
		gocql.Batch field Kind cql.BatchKind
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Len() int
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Reset()
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Size() int
	type gocql.CASBatchRows[X any] struct
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) All(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) iter.Seq2[*cql.CASResult[X], error]
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Applied() (bool, error)
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Clone() (cql.CASResult[X], error)
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Close() error
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Err() error
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) NextInto(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) bool
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Result() cql.Result
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	func gocql.Connect(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config) (*gocql.Session, error)
	const gocql.MaxBatchStatements untyped int = 65535
	type gocql.Page[R any] struct
		gocql.Page method (*T) All(dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Page method (*T) Clone() (R, error)
		gocql.Page method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.Page method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Page method (*T) Err() error
		gocql.Page method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		gocql.Page method (*T) Result() cql.Result
		gocql.Page method (*T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
		gocql.Page method (*T) State() cql.PageState
	type gocql.PageLease struct
		gocql.PageLease method (*T) Close() error
	type gocql.Prepared[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Apply(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) BindMarkers() cql.Columns
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Routing(value P, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (routing.Info, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) With(defaults execopt.CompiledOptions) *gocql.Prepared[P, R]
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Worker() (*gocql.Worker[P, R], error)
	type gocql.PreparedInfo struct
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Keyspace string
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Table string
		gocql.PreparedInfo field PartitionKeyIndexes []int
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Kind cql.StatementKind
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Generation uint64
	type gocql.PreparedStream[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) BindMarkers() cql.Columns
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) With(defaults execopt.CompiledOptions) *gocql.PreparedStream[P, R]
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Worker(options ...execopt.StreamOptions) (*gocql.StreamWorker[P, R], error)
	type gocql.RowStream[R any] struct
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) All(dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Err() error
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Progress() gocql.StreamProgress
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Result() cql.Result
	type gocql.Rows[R any] struct
		gocql.Rows method (T) All(dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Rows method (T) Clone() (R, error)
		gocql.Rows method (T) Close() error
		gocql.Rows method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Rows method (T) Err() error
		gocql.Rows method (T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		gocql.Rows method (T) Result() cql.Result
		gocql.Rows method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.Session struct
		gocql.Session method (*T) ApplyBatch(ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) AwaitSchemaAgreement(ctx context.Context) error
		gocql.Session method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.Session method (*T) Closed() bool
		gocql.Session method (*T) CompileOptions(options execopt.Options) (execopt.CompiledOptions, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) DefaultProfile() config.Profile
		gocql.Session method (*T) Dialect() config.Dialect
		gocql.Session method (*T) ExecBatch(ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) HostMetrics(dst []metrics.Host) []metrics.Host
		gocql.Session method (*T) ID() cql.UUID
		gocql.Session method (*T) Metadata() *metadata.Snapshot
		gocql.Session method (*T) Metrics() metrics.Snapshot
		gocql.Session method (*T) MustCompileOptions(options execopt.Options) execopt.CompiledOptions
		gocql.Session method (*T) Observer() observe.Hooks
		gocql.Session method (*T) Prepare[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], options ...execopt.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.Prepared[P, R], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) PrepareStream[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.StreamStatement[P, R], options ...execopt.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.PreparedStream[P, R], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) RefreshMetadata(ctx context.Context) (*metadata.Snapshot, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) RunConditionalBatch[X any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[cql.CASResult[X]], options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (gocql.CASBatchRows[X], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) Subscribe(filter event.Filter) (*event.Subscription, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedAddToBatch[P, R any](batch *gocql.Batch, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P) error
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedAll[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedCommand(ctx context.Context, statement string, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedEach[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedExec[P any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, cql.EmptyRow], value P, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedOne[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...execopt.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
	var gocql.StopIteration error
	type gocql.StreamProgress struct
		gocql.StreamProgress field Pages int64
		gocql.StreamProgress field OutputStarted bool
	type gocql.StreamWorker[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.StreamWorker method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.StreamWorker method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (*gocql.RowStream[R], error)
		gocql.StreamWorker method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
	type gocql.Worker[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.Worker method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		gocql.Worker method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Apply(ctx context.Context, value P) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
		gocql.Worker method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error

package auth
	type auth.Exchange interface
		auth.Exchange method Challenge(context.Context, cql.Nullable[[]byte]) (cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)
		auth.Exchange method Close()
		auth.Exchange method Success(context.Context, cql.Nullable[[]byte]) error
	func auth.Password(username string, password string, allowed ...string) auth.Provider
	const auth.PasswordAuthenticator untyped string = "org.apache.cassandra.auth.PasswordAuthenticator"
	type auth.Provider interface
		auth.Provider method Start(ctx context.Context, host metadata.HostSnapshot, authenticator string) (auth.Exchange, cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)
	const auth.ScyllaSaslauthdAuthenticator untyped string = "com.scylladb.auth.SaslauthdAuthenticator"
	const auth.ScyllaTransitionalAuthenticator untyped string = "com.scylladb.auth.TransitionalAuthenticator"

		cql.CodecError field Path string
		cql.CodecError field Stage cql.CodecStage
		cql.CodecError field Index int

	type cql.CodecStage string
	const cql.CodecStageCompile cql.CodecStage = "compile"
	const cql.CodecStageDecode cql.CodecStage = "decode"
	const cql.CodecStageEncode cql.CodecStage = "encode"
	const cql.CodecStageStreamCompile cql.CodecStage = "stream compile"
	const cql.CodecStageStreamDecode cql.CodecStage = "stream decode"

		cql.Columns method (T) Index(name string) (int, bool)
		cql.Columns method (T) Len() int

	type cql.CompiledRow[R any] interface

		cql.CompiledStreamRow method Reset(*R)

		retry.FixedSpeculation method (T) Delay(s retry.Speculation) (time.Duration, bool)
	type retry.NeverRetry struct
		retry.NeverRetry method (T) Decide(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	const retry.Next retry.Action = 2
	type retry.NoSpeculation struct
		retry.NoSpeculation method (T) Delay(retry.Speculation) (time.Duration, bool)
	type retry.Policy interface
		retry.Policy method Decide(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	type retry.PolicyFunc func(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
		retry.PolicyFunc method (T) Decide(a retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	type retry.Safe struct
		retry.Safe field MaxAttempts int
		retry.Safe method (T) Decide(a retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	const retry.Same retry.Action = 1
	type retry.Speculation struct
		retry.Speculation field Context context.Context
		retry.Speculation field Keyspace string
		retry.Speculation field Table string
		retry.Speculation field Started int
		retry.Speculation field Elapsed time.Duration
		retry.Speculation field LatencyP50 time.Duration
		retry.Speculation field LatencyP95 time.Duration
		retry.Speculation field LatencyP99 time.Duration
		retry.Speculation field Consistency cql.Consistency

	type retry.SpeculationPolicyFunc func(retry.Speculation) (time.Duration, bool)

	const retry.Stop retry.Action = 0
